title: New constraints on the structure of the nuclear stellar cluster of the Milky Way from star counts and MIR imaging

evidence.locator: Abstract: the nuclear star cluster is flattened with an axis ratio q = 0.71 +/- 0.10, an effective radius R_e = 5.1 +/- 1.0 pc and a Sérsic index n = 2.2 +/- 0.7; its major axis may be tilted out of the Galactic plane by up to -10 degrees.

statements.text: Cite Gallego-Cano et al. (2020), A&A 634, A71.
statements.scope: Shape of the Milky Way's nuclear star cluster
